verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Postman publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at learning.postman.com/openapi.json (valid 'openapi' key), and Postman's own developer API docs and Spec Hub further support spec-based API design/consumption. This directly satisfies the AI-native need to fetch a structured API spec. Missing for 10: no independent/community corroboration of using this spec file in real workflows, and no explicit versioning/documentation of the spec's completeness.
